answer: Resist Sybils with work-thread continuity. Every identity earns through one unbroken thread of peer-verified jobs: each completed job extends the thread and raises its earning cap, while a hollow gap with no verifiable output stains the record umber and collapses the thread to zero trust. A fresh identity starts with a tiny thread and must do real, checked work to grow it. A Sybil farm cannot idle a thousand clones: each hollow shell earns nothing, and keeping every thread alive costs continuous verified labor plus a stake lost when caught faking work. Scale demands real work, not copies.
